name: Damson Madder

notes: About page: 'Damson Madder was born in the Spring of 2020'; responsible practices, transparency and small-batch production; 'Exciting design, enduring quality, conscious production'. meta.json: London, GB.

US terms (delivery page): FedEx Standard $12, free on orders over $250; 'Damson Madder covers any and all duties & tariff charges for US orders'; local taxes charged at checkout. Cart banner: free exchanges for all US orders; 'As we are a British based brand, your products ... will have UK sizing on labels.'
Returns: full-price items within 28 days of delivery, sale items 14 days; US refund return label costs $20 (UPS); exchanges free for US customers.
US store sells sizes 2–16 on 331 apparel products; the UK store lists the same items as 6–20 (UK). Jeans run W24–W40.
Responsibility page: in 2025 over 92% of its cotton was organic or recycled, supported by GOTS, OCS or GRS certification; over 75% of fibres plant-based; under 5% virgin synthetics.
